findings.current: If you need to add anything, spit it out yourself.
findings.defect: The source asks whether he needs any further explanation, not whether he has something to add. This changes the target of the taunt.
findings.rationale: The Korean says “혹시 부연 설명이 더 필요하면” (“if you need further explanation”). The accepted baseline also preserves that meaning.
findings.replacement: If you need more explanation, spit it out yourself.

findings.current: Fear and anger, shock. And, last of all, confusion at not knowing what to do.
findings.defect: The assembled copy omits someone sucking in a breath and the narrator sensing a whirl of emotions from the guards.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes both the swallowed breath and the narrator sensing a swirl of emotions from the men on the wall; both details appear in the accepted baseline.
findings.replacement: Someone sucked in a breath. I sensed a whirl of emotions from the countless guards crowding the top of the wall. Fear and anger, shock. And, last of all, confusion at not knowing what to do.

summary: The assembled copy is largely faithful, but it changes the request for further explanation and omits a brief action and emotional image preserved in the source and accepted baseline.
